throughline.zh: AI 的商業效益，正受到硬體成本、供應鏈、人才與能源條件共同影響。
throughline.en: AI economics increasingly depend on hardware costs, supply chains, skills and energy conditions.

title.zh: AI 晶片競爭轉向整套系統成本
title.en: AI-chip competition shifts toward system cost

summary.zh: 微軟公布 Maia 300，規劃 2027 年部署。重點是每次推論的完整成本，宣稱的效能優勢仍待獨立測試。
summary.en: Microsoft announced Maia 300 for planned 2027 deployment. Total inference cost is the key question; claimed advantages still need independent testing.

title.zh: DRAM 漲價推高南亞科獲利

summary.zh: 南亞科第三季自結毛利率達 85.7%，但出貨量下降。這次成長主要看價格，後續要追蹤供給、庫存與漲價能否延續。
summary.en: Nanya reported a preliminary Q3 gross margin of 85.7% despite lower shipments. Pricing matters more than volume; watch supply, inventories and price durability.

title.zh: AI 硬體升級也帶來專利與製程門檻
title.en: AI hardware upgrades face legal and process constraints

summary.zh: USITC 啟動垂直供電系統調查；TPCA 展聚焦玻璃核心與先進封裝。立案未代表侵權成立，玻璃核心也仍有可靠度與量產挑戰。
summary.en: The USITC opened a vertical-power-delivery investigation, while TPCA highlights glass cores and packaging. An investigation is not a ruling; production reliability remains a hurdle.

title.zh: 企業 Agent 導入更重視整合與資安
title.en: Enterprise agents put integration and security in focus

summary.zh: HCLTech 與 Anthropic 合作導入企業 Agent；IonQ 簽約收購 Elisity，交易仍待核准。合作與收購提供方向，實際採用與效益還需營運數據。
summary.en: HCLTech and Anthropic announced an enterprise-agent partnership; IonQ signed an Elisity acquisition subject to approvals. Adoption and benefits still require operating evidence.

title.zh: 新聞內容授權成為 AI 成本的一部分
title.en: News licensing becomes part of the AI cost debate

summary.zh: 更多出版商加入 SPUR，推動追蹤 AI 使用新聞內容與授權規則。下一步看技術標準、實際授權條件及採用情況，聯盟擴大尚不等於模式已落地。
summary.en: More publishers joined SPUR to track AI use and licensing of news. Watch standards, licensing terms and adoption; membership growth does not establish implementation.

title.zh: AI 招聘變化需與失業率分開解讀
title.en: AI-related hiring changes are not unemployment rates

summary.zh: IMF 研究指出，AI 高適用性職種招聘需求約下降 10%，AI 技能需求增加。職缺、就業與薪資衡量不同，不能把招聘降幅直接當成失業增幅。
summary.en: An IMF study reports roughly 10% lower hiring demand in highly AI-applicable occupations and growing AI-skill demand. Vacancy changes do not translate directly into unemployment.

title.zh: 能源安全牽動出口路徑與危機融資
title.en: Energy security affects export routes and crisis financing

summary.zh: 沙國規劃增加管線輸油能力；世銀與 30 至 40 國討論危機援助。兩者都是應對風險的安排，輸油能力尚未完成，援助討論也不代表已撥款。
summary.en: Saudi Arabia plans greater pipeline export capacity; the World Bank is discussing crisis aid with 30–40 countries. Planned capacity is not installed capacity, and talks are not disbursements.
